mentions.name: Gethly
mentions.description: Sales and hosting platform for digital content creators offering paywalled content hosting, with a mobile UI currently in development. It supports micropayments so creators can charge as little as 1 cent for access. A planned 'Paywall As A Service' feature will let signed-up creators host their content remotely while Gethly manages finances and content access.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am finishing mobile UI for Gethly(sales and hosting platform for digital content creators - paywalled content hosting). It is taking a bit longer than I wanted but it will be done soon. But I am looking forward to August because I will be implementing a new feature - Paywall As A Service, which will allow content creators signed up with Gethly to host their content remotely and Gethly will manage finances and content access.
